<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/proficiency/me"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Only the caller's OWN profile, never someone else's. The opt-out comes along because without it the next round would re-derive everything and the deletion would be cosmetic. It is `viewer` on purpose: profiling covers all members, so requiring `developer` would leave a profiled viewer unable to delete their own.
